bloodmoon.message.blood.start: ☾ The Blood Moon rises... the dead are restless.
bloodmoon.message.blood.end: The Blood Moon fades with the dawn.
bloodmoon.message.super.start: ☾ The SUPER BLOOD MOON rises. May the gods protect you.
bloodmoon.message.super.end: The Super Blood Moon retreats... for now.
bloodmoon.message.golden.start: ☾ A Golden Moon lights up the night.
bloodmoon.message.golden.end: The Golden Moon sinks below the horizon.
bloodmoon.command.status.next: Next (days, 0 = tonight) — Blood: %s · Super: %s · Golden: %s · Moonless: %s
bloodmoon.command.summon.ok: A Rider of the Apocalypse was summoned.
bloodmoon.command.summon.fail: Could not summon the Rider of the Apocalypse.
bloodmoon.message.moonless.start: ☾ The moon did not rise tonight... the sky tears open. Something is watching.
bloodmoon.message.moonless.end: The eye closes. The rift seals... for now.
bloodmoon.message.emissary: ☾ Something has descended from the rift... the ground trembles beneath its steps.
